change: Optional hidden BIOS startup preserving original initialization and complete guest execution

behavior.default: Show; existing settings versions 1-3 retain visible startup
behavior.skip: No presentation, output PCM or wall pacing until cartridge entry and a complete game frame; original supplied BIOS still runs
behavior.persistence: PhoneOptions version 4, independent of guest MachineState format 1
behavior.lifecycle: Applies to fresh open/restart; state load restores exact scene; hidden work uses one frame budgets with input/commands/PCM draining between budgets
behavior.failure: Report BIOS that does not reach cartridge within 10 guest seconds

validation.native_session_first_frame: Synthetic red BIOS then white cartridge: Show submits red; Skip submits only white
validation.sdk_and_rapc: Passed; JDE 7.1 / ECJ 4.6.1; development COD/JAD, no release ZIP or tag

reproduce: Compile tools/BiosStartupReplayProbe.java against target/classes; pass report.json and local scenario.properties files identifying ROM/BIOS paths and SHA-256 values. Compare complete MachineState, RGB and drained PCM after every guest frame.
capture: Production menu/renderer via headless Java2D at 640x480; target/boot-gallery-current/settings.png
limitations: Host/session-double and SDK results are separate from BBOS runtime measurements; skipping BIOS presentation does not remove computation cost.
